question:
During triage in MongoDB Document Modeling BSON, an engineer observes:
"System fault during operation: BSONObjectTooLarge Error on Unbounded Sensor Array".
What is the verified root cause?

options.text: IoT readings appended continuously into a single document array without capping, eventually breaching the 16MB document size limit.
Query written as MATCH (a:Person), (b:Company) WHERE a.city = b.city without a relationship pattern, forcing an exhaustive $N \times M$ Cartesian product in RAM.
Writer released parent latch before acquiring child latch during downward traversal, allowing a concurrent split to invalidate node pointers.
Either a late-arriving dimension row, or reprocessing a partition out of chronological order.

explanation:
Root Cause: IoT readings appended continuously into a single document array without capping, eventually breaching the 16MB document size limit.

Fix Resolution:
Implement the Time-Series Bucket Pattern: store at most 500 readings per document bucket and insert a new document when bucket reaches capacity.
